content:
７ Note
To locate files and quarantine them, the query results should also include DeviceId  values
as device identifiers.
Apart from device-focused remediation steps, you can also take some actions on emails from
your query results. Select the records you want to take action on, select Take actions, then
under Choose actions, select your choice from the following:
Move to mailbox folder  - select this action to move the email messages to Junk, Inbox, or
Deleted items folder
Note that you can move email results consisting of quarantined items (for instance, in the
case of false positives) by selecting the Inbox option.

